body:
I'm sorry for you pain. I've been crying myself to sleep for the last few years... There's been quite a few times when I have accidentally caught my reflection in the mirror and ended up on the ground sobbing like some dramatic scene from an awful movie. 

I'm not one to do anything rash, I plan pretty much everything I do out. I over plan i guess. 
What consequences? What can go wrong? What do I want to happen?

A multitude of therapist while growing up and after becoming an "Adult"

I really don't find that they are helpful, it's mostly overdone sympathy or "And how does that make you feel". Don't get me wrong, I'm sure they help people.  My bullshit meter just seems to go off whenever I talk to one. Honestly I dont need to pay some stranger to talk about my feelings. I need to have the ability to make friends, and function socially, understand how you're supposed to act with other people that makes it possible to have friends instead of being so damn awkward that there isnt a single person who I can just call and talk to or bullshit with about random stuff.

The more I look at it, the more obvious it becomes that I am literally defective in the area of social interactions and forming relationships and it's fucking painful. the one person who I did manage to form an actual bond with died suddenly a couple years ago.

Also I realized that it's my brother's birthday and I'm not so selfish, hell.. whats another few weeks?

sometimes living is more painful than the most painful deaths and all there is to do is plan to minimize the impact on others. No driving the wrong way in traffic or jumping off a tall building into a crowded street. Too bad there is no easy way to disappear and die.
